detail.longDescription:
Finally migrating stuff from #GitHub to @Codeberg@social.anoxinon.de! Really wonderful experience so far. I've started with my personal websites. (https://erikjanvankesteren.nl)

I've rented a VPS for page hosting using Caddy, and I use webhooks (via https://github.com/adnanh/webhook) to sync changes to my static site repos on codeberg immediately to the server. 

Much faster and cleaner than GitHub actions! 

#SelfHosting
